title: Dynamic prices
lead: The hub takes a price for every 15-minute period from a provider you choose and books energy at it. Here you see today's and tomorrow's prices, where they come from, and set cheap windows.
directOnly: Dynamic prices are set over a direct connection to the hub.
loadFailed: Couldn't read the prices from the hub: {why}
noPrices: No prices stored yet. The hub fetches them on its own; tomorrow's usually arrive after 13:00 CET.
tomorrowLater: Tomorrow's prices aren't in yet; they usually arrive after 13:00 CET.
chartAria: Price per 15-minute period, today and tomorrow
stripBackup: From the backup or Home Assistant
stripPlan: From the plan (no price for the period)
stateHint.backup: The primary provider has no price for now; the hub uses the backup.
stateHint.today_only: It's after 15:00 UTC and tomorrow's prices haven't arrived. The hub keeps trying; until then, tomorrow is priced by the plan.
stateHint.stale: Home Assistant is the primary source and nothing covers now. Check the integration that pushes prices.
stateHint.plan_fallback: No stored price covers now, so the hub books energy at the plan's zone rate.
err.http_status: the provider answered with an error
err.parse: the provider's answer couldn't be read
err.rate_limited: too many requests; the hub retries later
enabledHint: Each 15-minute period is priced by the provider below; where it has no price, by the backup, else by the tariff plan.
disabledHint: Off: energy is priced by the tariff plan. Prices pushed from Home Assistant still apply, as a spot price.
backupHint: Used for any period the provider has no price for.
backupSame: The backup must differ from the provider.
zoneCurrency: This zone is priced in {zone}, the plan in {plan}. Set the plan's currency to {zone} on Tariffs first; the hub converts no currencies.
haClassHint: Spot: the plan's fees and VAT are added. All-in: used as is.
tokenSet: A token is stored. Type a new one to replace it.
exportProductHint: Empty: no export prices from Octopus.
formulaSpot: Buy price = (market price × factor + markup [+ the plan's zone rate] + the plan's per-kWh fees) × (1 + VAT).
formulaAllIn: This provider's price already includes fees and VAT; it is used as is.
perKwhHint: per kWh, in the plan's currency
zonesStackHint: For time-of-use grid fees on top of the market price (e.g. day/night network rates).
hourlyMeanHint: Some suppliers bill each hour at the mean of its four 15-minute prices.
sellMode.sourceHint: The provider's export price where it has one, else the plan's.
sellMode.planHint: Export is priced by the tariff plan.
sellMode.formulaHint: Sell price = market price × export factor − export fee.
notOnThisHub: This hub doesn't report dynamic prices: they need hub firmware 1.2.0 or later. The Tariffs page has the plan the hub prices by.
